# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. Rolls up the entire v4 preview line through m132 to m148. Adds variable font support end-to-end, animated WebP encoding, zero-copy stream conversion, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from any 3.x version.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKPaint text and font state-reading APIs are now compile errors** — The paint text/font members obsoleted in v3 (`Typeface`, `TextSize`, `TextSkewX`, etc. read via SKPaint) are now errors in 4.x. Move typeface and text size configuration to SKFont. Pre-v4 obsoletes and enum aliases were also promoted to errors. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface — set one explicitly** — Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (zero glyphs); MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Construct with an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect 'unset' with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan terminates the process on Vulkan 1.0 — require 1.1** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 (upstream m139/m140). A Vulkan 1.0 instance no longer returns null — Skia calls SK_ABORT and the process terminates. Declare 1.1 in both VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion; leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 (the old default) is unsafe.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five legacy fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed from the interop struct. Delete those assignments. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, and fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures.
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo and lost value-equality** — The Ycbcr conversion info struct follows the GR casing convention and no longer implements IEquatable or == / !=. Update the type name and any equality checks at the call site.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter on IgnorePublicDispose is removed. Subclasses that assigned to it must switch to constructor-time initialization or the overridable property pattern.
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete** — The native stream offset is 32-bit. The long overload previously silently truncated large values; it now throws OverflowException on out-of-range input and carries [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) directly, clamping or validating the value first.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through m132, m133, and m147 to m148** — The bundled engine advances from the 3.x Skia pin all the way to m148, picking up three years of upstream fixes. Several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix merges keep the engine stable. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4054))
- **Singleton lifecycle rework** — SKObject singleton instances (contexts, surfaces created from external handles) are now tracked and disposed in a deterministic order, fixing races and double-dispose crashes seen with Ganesh and Graphite context teardown. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Managed default typeface resolution** — Default typeface lookup moves to the managed layer, fixing Android API 36+ crashes where the native path could return null. Every platform now guarantees a non-null SKTypeface.Default. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Legacy font manager entry point restored** — The Skia shim regains sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface, restoring compatibility for downstream code relying on the legacy typeface factory. ([#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color font palette support** — Variable font axes, instances, and named styles are exposed end-to-end through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. SKFont and SKTypeface gain color font palette selection and robust variable-font handling. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder can now emit animated WebP files from a frame sequence, closing the gap alongside the existing animated WebP decoder. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion** — Turn any seekable stream into an SKData without an intermediate byte[] copy — useful when handing decoded assets to codecs, shaders, or external consumers. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — New overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can choose mipmap and filter mode for surface-to-surface draws instead of accepting the implicit default. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzz wrappers** — HarfBuzzSharp gets a proper HBColor value type matching hb_color_t, and fills in wrappers that had been missing or mis-named, moving toward full API coverage. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride (not Width × bpp) and the correct axis for the (x, y) offset, fixing silently-wrong pixel data on non-packed bitmaps. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first** — A GC ordering race that crashed the process during finalization when an SKPathBuilder was collected before the SKPath it produced is now fixed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI no longer fails with a DLL-not-found error on .NET 9 WinAppSDK projects; the projection assembly is now resolved correctly. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView blank after MAUI TabBar switch** — Switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar no longer leaves SKGLView permanently blank; the GL surface is correctly re-attached when the view is re-added to the visual tree. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Platform

- **Tizen picks up x64 and arm64 native builds** — Tizen ships alongside the existing x86/arm slices; consumers on 64-bit Tizen devices no longer fall back to emulation. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Linux Bionic native assets** — Android-hosted Linux (linux-bionic) is a first-class native target — the runtime identifier resolves to purpose-built binaries instead of the desktop glibc build. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Apple TFMs aligned: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps** — Libraries target the versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) while sample apps use the unversioned ones, matching current .NET SDK guidance and unblocking MAUI-style consumers. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions** — .NET 8 is now the minimum for the SkiaSharp WASM native asset. Pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds are removed. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — libexpat 2.7.5 and 2.8.1, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 all pick up their latest upstream security and bug fixes. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates to HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with variable-font shaping and color font palette support wired end-to-end. Gains a proper HBColor value type for hb_color_t, and the singleton lifecycle rework improves disposal safety for long-lived shaping contexts.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

RC 1 landed the Skia m148 engine bump, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint text/font promotion to compile errors, the SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride fix, the WinUI DLL resolution fix, the native-compat gate move to the SkiaApi constructor, expat 2.8.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Preview 3 delivered HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM Emscripten builds, and updated freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer crash fix, Apple TFM alignment, and libexpat 2.7.5 / libpng 1.6.58 security refreshes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the v4 line: Skia m132 → m133 → m147, variable font and color palette support end-to-end, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws, managed default-typeface resolution, Tizen x64/arm64, Linux Bionic, and the PolySharp C# 13 shim.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
